inout.r_ck_h.one: {n} thing to look at before you return these
inout.r_ck_h.other: {n} things to look at before you return these

inout.r_ck_click: Click a name to go there.
inout.r_ck_ok: All clear: everyone is scored, scores match the papers, and every file is marked.
inout.r_ck_disagree: Scores that disagree with the paper ({n})
inout.r_ck_bad: it couldn’t be opened, so it won’t be in the export
inout.r_early_untick: Untick to send theirs again with everyone else’s.
inout.r_early_again: Theirs go again with everyone else’s.
inout.r_key_none: No file has proofreading marks yet.
inout.r_ai_papers_s: A ZIP of every page as a picture
inout.r_ai_marks_s: One file: scores, rubric and your marks
inout.r_ai_back_s: Paste a reply, and it goes to each student

inout.r_rs_n.one: {n} page is flagged for a rescan
inout.r_rs_n.other: {n} pages are flagged for a rescan

inout.qs_marked: {n} of {of} questions marked in Quick mark
inout.score_vs_paper: Your score is {a}, the paper says {b}
inout.score_vs_word: Your score is {a}, the Word rubric says {b}
inout.bf_text: Each file goes to its student by the name in its file name or folder name, for example your marked rubrics. You check the matches before anything is added.
inout.bf_late: pick the late files, or the whole new download. What’s already here is left out, and you can mark anyone late as you add them.
inout.bf_scan: (like a makeup day): split it page by page onto names, and each student’s pages are added to them here.
inout.mr_text: For files that aren’t in one folder per student, like rubrics you marked outside Grading Studio. Each file is matched to a student on your roster by the name in its file name or folder name, and you can fix any match.
inout.bf_mac_perm: macOS didn’t let Grading Studio open that folder. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders.
inout.f_marks_kept: Your marks on it are still saved.
inout.f_goes_back: It goes back with the export because you added it.
inout.op_later: When their work comes in, use {bring} under {setup}, or {add} on their paper.
